mechanism_claim.functional_claim: POET orders candidate environments by NOVELTY before its minimal criterion decides admission. novelty.py:18-62 computes that novelty as: reduce an environment to five numbers (env2array: ground_roughness, pit_gap[0], pit_gap[1], stump_height[0], stump_height[1], substituting ZERO wherever a list is empty); take the unnormalised Euclidean distance to every member of the archive; return the MEAN OF THE k SMALLEST distances. CLAIM: as written this estimator has three properties that are consequences of the code rather than of the search problem, and all three are decidable on the fossil's own bytes. (1) IT CHANGES WHAT IT MEASURES: argsort()[:k] silently returns fewer than k elements when the archive holds fewer than k members, so for |archive| < k the value is the mean distance to the WHOLE archive (a global dispersion measure) and for |archive| >= k it is the mean distance to the k nearest (a local density measure); no discontinuity is flagged. (2) IT IS SCALE-BLIND: compute_novelty_vs_archive calls euclidean_distance with normalize=False hardcoded, so the norm vector [8,8,8,3,3] declared inside that very function is never applied and a change of a given FRACTION of a feature's own declared range contributes to the distance in proportion to that range, making roughness/pit features dominate stump features. (3) IT CONFLATES ABSENCE WITH ZERO: an environment with no pit and an environment with a pit of width zero map to the same descriptor point and are exactly indistinguishable. Together these make novelty DEFLATE monotonically as the archive grows -- and because delete_optimizer never prunes env_archive, it deflates against environments that are no longer in the active population at all.
mechanism_claim.claimed_inputs: an archive of Env_config namedtuples and one candidate Env_config; the neighbour count k (k=5 at POET's call site)
mechanism_claim.claimed_outputs: a scalar novelty score used to sort the child list high-to-low before the minimal criterion is applied
mechanism_claim.claimed_internal_dependency: the score depends ONLY on env2array's five fields and the archive contents; it is invariant to archive insertion order (the distances are sorted); it consults no agent, no score and no simulation. env2array always returns length 5, so the ragged n != m branch of euclidean_distance (novelty.py:44-50) is dead code for this descriptor
mechanism_claim.known_uncertainty: whether these properties materially change POET's trajectory in a full run is NOT claimed here and is not tested by this packet: the full algorithm needs Box2D and fiber workers, absent on M3. This packet establishes the estimator's behaviour, not its consequence for open-endedness.
